{{Quote|I don't want to go into too much detail, but I received a report on untapped kolto reserves. The trouble is this report comes from the Empire. Given their recent activities here, I feel like acting on this information requires clearance from the Office of Ethics. I thought I'd send it up the chain before I get demoted to something boring, like alphabetizing visitor log archives at the Visitor's Center.|[[Go Kila]], to [[Hu Joomi]]|<ref name="TOR:MtN" />}}
The '''Office of Ethics''' was a civil body on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] that dealt with the ethical needs of the Manaan government.

==History==
{{Quote|I think it strange for the Office of Ethics to be so capitulating to the so-called "alarmists in the popular press." Surely, the "ethical" thing to do is foment peace with whomever we can. We see this report as a positive step toward normalizing relations with the Empire, once this has all blown over.|The [[Director of the Office of Extraplanetary Relations]]|<ref name="TOR:MtN" />}}
During the time of the [[Invasion of Manaan]], [[Go Kila]] of the [[Office of Extraplanetary Relations]] came into possession of a report about untapped [[Kolto/Legends|Kolto]] reserves discovered by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and forwarded a request to the Office of Ethics for comment. Unofficially, [[Hu Joomi]] told Go Kila to 'misfile' the report due to fears it would lead to a civil war, however the report ultimately surfaced and the [[Director of the Office of Ethics|Director]] urgently sent a message to all the staff of the Office warning them not to talk to the press, and sent the same message to the [[Director of the Office of Extraplanetary Relations]], who ignored it.<ref name="TOR:MtN" />
